messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — metering-service token-aggregation drift detected (emit rate mismatch). Root: token-aggregator v2 deployment 03:05 UTC
alice: I'm on it. Observing a ~18% token count delta vs baseline across prod-emit-rcp in the last 5m. Any rollback in progress?
ben: Not rolled yet. I see a spike in partial-ack retries to emitter, backlog in redis stream. Suspect a change in batching strategy.
carla: Customer-impact check: billing-alerts queue shows ~120 overage flags queued for 30m users. Need to pause flagging if counts unreliable.
dave: Support seeing increased tickets for "unexpected charges". Holding customers until we confirm counts.
alice: Action items: 1) Ben -> rollback token-aggregator v2 to v1 (if safe) 2) Carla -> suspend auto-overage flagging via feature flag 3) Ben -> queue backfill job to reconcile once stable
ben: Rolling back now. kubectl rollout undo deployment/token-aggregator -n prod --to-revision=1
ben: Rollback completed, pod count healthy. Watching emit metrics.
alice: Good. Carla, please flip flag. Command: PATCH /admin/feature_flags {"suspend_metering_alerts": true}
carla: Flag flipped. Confirmed in UI and audit logs. :thumbsup:
dave: Notifying affected customers to hold on billing adjustments.
ben: Metrics show token-delta dropping to 1.2% over baseline after rollback, redis stream backlog draining.
alice: Next: schedule a short Backfill window: start at 03:40 UTC, run reconcile with dedupe keys, generate corrected usage deltas, put into shadow billing pipeline for validation.
carla: Agree. Will hold off any bill generation until reconciliation completes. Also preparing customer comms template.
alice: On-call handoff: Ben will be primary for the next 2 hours to watch for regressions. Ben, if stable after 90m, re-enable alerting with a quick smoke test.
ben: Roger, I'll monitor and post an update once backfill finishes.
pagerbot: Incident resolved (triaged) — severity: P2. Root cause: batching change in token-aggregator v2 increased partial-ack retries and duplicate emits. Actions: rollback, suspend flags, backfill. Postmortem: assign to eng-metric-team.
carla: Filing billing-impact report and tagging customers for credit review.
alice: Thanks team. Preparing brief for all-hands. Closing thread once postmortem is created.
